info.title: GPT All-Model API - Chat Completions Reference
info.description: Full parameter reference for calling GPT series text models through the OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API.

post.summary: GPT Chat Completions (All Models, Full Parameters)
post.description:
- OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API for GPT series text models; select the specific model via `model` (see the comparison table on the `model` parameter for all allowed values)
- The whole series consists of reasoning models, with reasoning depth controlled by `reasoning_effort`; reasoning tokens are billed as output tokens
- Prompt caching applies automatically: cached input tokens are billed at the lower cached rate
- Supports both synchronous and streaming (SSE) modes
- Supports mixed text, image, and PDF file input, as well as `function` tool calls
- Server-side tools (web search, MCP) are provided only on the [Responses API](/en/api-manual/language-series/gpt/responses/responses-reference)
- Omit `temperature` and `top_p` on `gpt-6.2-astra` / `gpt-6.2-sol` / `gpt-6-astra` / `gpt-6.1-sol`. On the other listed models, adjust sampling only at reasoning effort `none`.

For Chat function calling on `gpt-6-sol` / `gpt-6-luna`, set `reasoning_effort: "none"` explicitly. Use [Responses](/en/api-manual/language-series/gpt/responses/responses-reference) for function calling on `gpt-6.2-astra` / `gpt-6.2-sol` / `gpt-6-astra` / `gpt-6.1-sol` / `gpt-6.1-terra` and for GPT-6 `max` reasoning effort.

200.description: Chat completion succeeded (a JSON object; when `stream=true`, an SSE event stream terminated by `data: [DONE]`)

400.description: Invalid request parameters (including parameters not supported by the model; the error message indicates the specific parameter name). When a server-side tool (such as `web_search`) or `web_search_options` is declared, `error.code` is `invalid_built_in_tool`

error.message: Unsupported parameter: 'stop' is not supported with this model.

messages.description:
List of chat messages, supporting multi-turn context and multimodal input.

`role` can be `system` / `developer` / `user` / `assistant` / `tool`.

`content` can be a string or an array of content blocks. Three block types are supported: `text` (text), `image_url` (image), and `file` (PDF file):

```json
"content": [
  { "type": "text", "text": "What is in this image?" },
  {
    "type": "image_url",
    "image_url": { "url": "https://example.com/photo.png", "detail": "auto" }
  }
]
```

**Image**
- Pass the public URL of the image in `image_url.url`
- `image_url` can also be written directly as a string, equivalent to `{ "url": "..." }`
- `detail` controls image analysis fidelity: `auto` (default) / `low` / `high` / `original`
- The image must be downloadable, otherwise `400` is returned

**Note** The block types on this API differ from those on the Responses API (which uses `input_text` / `input_image` / `input_file`). They cannot be mixed; using the wrong ones returns `400`.

Explicit cache breakpoint for GPT-6 / GPT-5.6, placed on a content block. Up to four writes per request; an implicit breakpoint uses one slot. `prompt_cache_breakpoint: {"mode": "explicit"}`.

stream.description: Whether to return the result as a stream (an SSE event stream terminated by `data: [DONE]`). Defaults to `false`.

max_completion_tokens.description: Maximum generated tokens, including reasoning. Prefer `max_completion_tokens`. GPT-6 accepts legacy `max_tokens` through conversion; if both are supplied, `max_completion_tokens` takes precedence and `max_tokens` is removed. GPT-6 Astra / Sol / Luna, GPT-6.1 Sol, and GPT-6.1 Terra support up to 128,000 output tokens.

reasoning_effort.description:
Reasoning depth control. The allowed values vary by model:

| Model | Allowed values |
|---|---|
| `gpt-6.2-astra` / `gpt-6.2-sol` / `gpt-6-astra` / `gpt-6.1-sol` | `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` |
| `gpt-6-sol` / `gpt-6-luna` / `gpt-6.1-terra` | `none`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` |
| `gpt-5.6-sol` / `gpt-5.6-terra` / `gpt-5.6-luna` / `gpt-5.5` | `none`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` |
| `gpt-5.4` / `gpt-5.2` | `none`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` |
| `gpt-5.1` | `none`, `low`, `medium`, `high` |

Reasoning tokens are billed as output tokens and counted in `usage.completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens`.

GPT-6 defaults to `medium`. `gpt-6.2-astra` / `gpt-6.2-sol` / `gpt-6-astra` and `gpt-6.1-sol` do not support `none`; `gpt-6-sol` / `gpt-6-luna` / `gpt-6.1-terra` do. GPT-6 `max` effort is available through Responses only.

`gpt-6.2-astra` / `gpt-6.2-sol` · Default reasoning effort · `medium`

response_format.description:
Output format control:

- `{"type": "text"}`: free-form text, the default
- `{"type": "json_object"}`: returns valid JSON, and **requires the word `json` to appear in `messages`**, otherwise `400` is returned
- `{"type": "json_schema", "json_schema": {...}}`: returns structured output following the given JSON Schema; combine it with `"strict": true` to enforce conformance to the schema

json_schema.description: Required when `type` is `json_schema`; contains the `name`, `schema`, and `strict` fields

verbosity.description:
How detailed the answer should be: `low` / `medium` / `high`.

Models · `gpt-6.2-astra` / `gpt-6.2-sol` / `gpt-6-astra` / `gpt-5.6-sol` / `gpt-5.6-terra` / `gpt-5.6-luna` / `gpt-5.5`

tools.description:
Tool list, used for function calling (client-side function calls, no per-call fee).

Server-side tools (web search and so on) are not provided on this API; use the [Responses API](/en/api-manual/language-series/gpt/responses/responses-reference) instead.

For Chat function calling on `gpt-6-sol` / `gpt-6-luna`, set `reasoning_effort: "none"` explicitly. Use [Responses](/en/api-manual/language-series/gpt/responses/responses-reference) for function calling on `gpt-6.2-astra` / `gpt-6.2-sol` / `gpt-6-astra` / `gpt-6.1-sol` / `gpt-6.1-terra` and for GPT-6 `max` reasoning effort.

tool_choice.description:
Tool choice control: `"auto"` (default) / `"none"` / `"required"`, or an object naming a specific function, such as `{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "get_weather"}}`.

Available on the same models as `tools`.

parallel_tool_calls.description:
Whether the model may call multiple tools in parallel within one turn. Defaults to `true`; set it to `false` to force calls one at a time.

Models · `gpt-6-astra` / `gpt-5.6-sol` / `gpt-5.6-terra` / `gpt-5.6-luna` / `gpt-5.5` / `gpt-5.4` / `gpt-5.2` / `gpt-5.1`

temperature.description:
Sampling temperature, ranging from 0 to 2. Lower values make the output more deterministic.

- Models requiring an explicit `{"reasoning_effort":"none"}` — `gpt-6.1-terra` / `gpt-6-sol` / `gpt-6-luna` / `gpt-5.6-sol` / `gpt-5.6-terra` / `gpt-5.6-luna` / `gpt-5.5`
- Models that default to `none` — `gpt-5.4` / `gpt-5.2` / `gpt-5.1`

Omit this parameter at other reasoning levels.

top_p.description:
Nucleus sampling parameter, ranging from 0 to 1. Adjusting it together with `temperature` is not recommended.

- Models requiring an explicit `{"reasoning_effort":"none"}` — `gpt-6.1-terra` / `gpt-6-sol` / `gpt-6-luna` / `gpt-5.6-sol` / `gpt-5.6-terra` / `gpt-5.6-luna` / `gpt-5.5`
- Models that default to `none` — `gpt-5.4` / `gpt-5.2` / `gpt-5.1`

Omit this parameter at other reasoning levels.

n.description:
Number of candidate replies to generate, returned as multiple entries in the `choices` array. All tokens (including the output of every candidate) are billed.

For multiple choices, use any listed model except `gpt-6.2-sol`.

logprobs.description:
Whether to return the log probabilities of each output token.

Models · `gpt-5.1` / `gpt-5.2` / `gpt-5.4` / `gpt-6-sol` / `gpt-6-luna` / `gpt-6.1-terra`

`reasoning_effort: "none"`

top_logprobs.description:
Maximum number of alternative tokens to return at each output position.

Models · `gpt-5.1` / `gpt-5.2` / `gpt-5.4` / `gpt-6-sol` / `gpt-6-luna` / `gpt-6.1-terra`

`reasoning_effort: "none"` · `logprobs: true`

frequency_penalty.description:
Frequency penalty, ranging from -2 to 2. Positive values penalize tokens by how often they have appeared, reducing repeated content.

Models · `gpt-5.4` / `gpt-5.2` / `gpt-5.1`

Models · `gpt-6-astra` · `0`

presence_penalty.description:
Presence penalty, ranging from -2 to 2. Positive values encourage the model to talk about new topics.

Models · `gpt-5.4` / `gpt-5.2` / `gpt-5.1`

Models · `gpt-6-astra` · `0`

prompt_cache_key.description: Cache grouping key. GPT-6 / GPT-5.6 route cache traffic automatically; this field is not needed to optimize routing. Separate keys can distinguish cache reuse and accounting for customers or users. Keep the key stable for requests that should reuse a prefix. Earlier models can use stable keys to help cache routing.

prompt_cache_options.description: Prompt caching options for GPT-6 and GPT-5.6. Implicit breakpoints are the default. `mode: "explicit"` uses only explicit breakpoints; without one, no caching occurs.

mode.description: `implicit` places breakpoints automatically; `explicit` uses only content-block `prompt_cache_breakpoint` markers.

seed.description:
Random seed. With the same seed and parameter combination, the model tries to return consistent results (best effort; full reproducibility is not guaranteed).

Models · `gpt-6-astra` / `gpt-5.6-sol` / `gpt-5.6-terra` / `gpt-5.6-luna` / `gpt-5.5` / `gpt-5.4` / `gpt-5.2` / `gpt-5.1`

content.description: Message content: a string, or an array of content blocks (a mix of `text` / `image_url` / `file`).
content.example: Explain quantum entanglement in one sentence.

type.description:
Content type

- `text`: Text block
- `image_url`: Image input
- `file`: File input (PDF)

image_url.description: Image input (when `type=image_url`). It can also be written directly as an image URL string, equivalent to `{ "url": "..." }`.

url.description: Public URL of the image. It must be downloadable, otherwise `400` is returned

detail.description:
Image analysis fidelity

- `low`: Low fidelity, consumes fewer tokens
- `high`: High fidelity, finer recognition
- `original`: Analyzed at the original image size
- `auto` (default): Decided automatically by the model

`GPT-6 Sol / Luna` / `GPT-6.1 Sol / Terra` · `auto`

file.description: File input (when `type=file`). PDF is supported; the file content is billed as input tokens, see `usage` in the response for actual consumption.

prompt_cache_breakpoint.description: Explicit cache breakpoint for GPT-6 / GPT-5.6, placed on a content block. Up to four writes per request; an implicit breakpoint uses one slot.

ContentBlock.description: Multimodal content block. Declare the type via `type` and fill in only the fields matching that type.

description.example: Get the weather for a specified city

parameters.description: Parameter definition in JSON Schema format

choices.description: List of generated results (length equals `n` in the request)

logprobs.description:
Log probability information, returned only when `logprobs` is enabled in the request

For `gpt-6.2-astra` and `gpt-6.2-sol`, omit `logprobs` and `top_logprobs`.

finish_reason.description: Finish reason: `stop` for a normal ending, `length` when the maximum token limit is reached, `tool_calls` when a tool call is required

content.description: Text content generated by the model; can be `null` when a tool call is triggered
content.example: Quantum entanglement means the states of two particles are correlated, so measuring one instantly determines the state of the other.

tool_calls.description: Tools the model requested to call

Usage.description:
Token usage statistics. Prompt caching applies automatically, and cached input tokens are billed at the lower cached rate.

GPT-6 bills uncached input, cache reads, cache writes, and output separately. For models with a 1,050,000-token context window (GPT-6.2, GPT-6.1, GPT-6, GPT-5.6, GPT-5.5, and GPT-5.4), when input exceeds 272,000 tokens, the entire request uses 2× the regular input and cache rates and 1.5× the output rate. Built-in image generation is billed separately. See current [model pricing](https://evolink.ai/pricing).

completion_tokens.description: Number of output tokens (includes reasoning tokens)

cached_tokens.description: Number of tokens served from cache

cache_write_tokens.description: Input tokens written to cache, billed at the cache-write rate rather than counted again as uncached input.

bearerAuth.description:
All APIs require Bearer Token authentication

**Get API Key:**

Visit [API Key Management Page](https://evolink.ai/dashboard/keys) to get your API Key

**Add to request header:**
```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```
